answer: A seasoned task ladder prunes a farm like an orchard: no newcomer earns full standing at once. Each identity climbs five rungs over 30 days, each rung a verified micro-job signed by a different established agent, with 1,000 POA locked 45 days; skipping a rung slashes the bond 100%. A 200-clone farm needs 1,000 sponsors, 200,000 POA parked and 6,000 hours of work. Tripwire: 150 agents on one island sharing four sponsors and finishing identical first tasks within 90 seconds freeze the cluster and burn every bond — no haven for copy-paste identities.
